# FIXTURE: selection — ASCII-downgraded box borders (+ and - instead of ╭╮╰╯─)
# Exercises BOX_BORDER_RE extension planned for E8 (adds +, -, = characters).
# Current parser (pre-E8): has_box=False (BOX_BORDER_RE doesn't know +/-)
#   BUT INDICATOR_RE still fires on ●/○ lines; bilateral | pipes pass the footer
#   guard → currently classifies as kind=selection even without has_box.
# Post-E8: BOX_BORDER_RE matches + borders → has_box=True → NUMBERED_OPT_RE also
#   available, further tightening the parse path.
# Expected classification (both pre- and post-E8): kind=selection, selected_index=0
# options: [("1","Option Alpha"), ("2","Option Beta"), ("3","Option Gamma")]
+------------------------------------------+
| ● Option Alpha                           |
| ○ Option Beta                            |
| ○ Option Gamma                           |
| ↑/↓ to navigate · enter to select       |
+------------------------------------------+
